text: 47-year-old woman with metastatic HER2+ breast cancer, ECOG 1, no prior trastuzumab. CBC within normal range. No history of brain metastases.
62-year-old man with stage IV NSCLC harboring an EGFR exon 19 deletion. Prior treatment with osimertinib (12 months) with progression. ECOG 1. No active CNS disease.
8-year-old boy with newly diagnosed B-cell ALL. WBC 25,000. CSF negative. No prior chemotherapy. ECOG 0.
